resources.string: The most you can spend on a single purchase.
The most you can spend on a single purchase. You\'re at the highest limit there is.
Verify one account you already own and buying unlocks. Cashing out is never limited by reputation.
We couldn\'t read your limits from the exchange. Nothing has changed — try again in a moment.
The exchange has blocked this wallet from trading. Verifying an account won\'t change that.
Buying is a trade with a stranger. You send money to their account; they release USDC to you. Neither of you can take the other\'s money back.

The exchange caps how much a new account can trade at once. A brand-new wallet can cash out but cannot buy — and cashing out doesn\'t count towards the buy limit, however long you\'ve been doing it. Verifying an account you already own is what raises the cap.
What Zapp can see: nothing. The proof says “this person controls an X account older than a year”. It carries no handle, no password, and nothing you\'ve posted.
Where the limit comes from: the exchange\'s contract on Base, not from Zapp. We read it; we can\'t raise it.
Verify an account you already own. Nothing is shared with Zapp.
Needs an account about a year old
Reclaim will open. Sign in to %1$s there, then come back.
Keep Zapp open. If you closed Reclaim before finishing, cancel here and start again.
You can now buy up to $%1$s in one purchase.
Verifying isn\'t available in this version of Zapp.
This account doesn\'t meet the provider\'s requirements — it must be about a year old.
Reclaim couldn\'t complete the check. Try again, or pick another account.
That verification expired. Start it again to get a fresh link.
That account is already verified on another wallet.
That verification was made for a different wallet. Start it again.
The exchange couldn\'t verify that proof.
We can\'t cover the network fee right now. Try again in a little while.
We couldn\'t reach the network. Try again in a moment.
Pick an account you already have.
Zapp opens Reclaim, a separate app that does the checking. Install it if you haven\'t — it\'s free.
Sign in to your account inside Reclaim. Zapp never sees that.
Reclaim produces a mathematical proof and hands it back. Zapp writes it to the exchange\'s contract, and your limit goes up.
We pay the network fee. You need no ETH and no other coin.
It takes a few minutes, mostly the Reclaim install and sign-in.
Older accounts only. X, GitHub and Instagram need an account about a year old. A newer one comes back as “criteria not met” — the provider\'s rule, not ours.
Once per account. The same X account can\'t be verified onto a second wallet — including a wallet you recover from a new seed.
